// diagnostic

L0535

`impl {head}` sits outside the body of `{type_name}`

What

`impl {head}` sits outside the body of `{type_name}`

Why

`{type_name}` is declared in this file, and a struct or enum holds its own impls; a top-level impl stays only where it has to be somewhere else

Fix

Move it into the body of `{type_name}`: its methods as `fn` members, a trait impl as a nested `impl Trait { … }`

Worked example
